findings.message: prose has outgrown the links. Move the detail into the documents this points at, and link to them from here.
missing required field 'frequency' (required when mechanism != not-enforced).
this control claims to run and does not say where the proof lives. Set `evidence` to the build log, the audit note or the dashboard.
missing required field 'retention' (required when classification in [personal, special-category]).
this address looks real. Write it under `example.com`, which RFC 2606 reserves so it can never be anybody's.
this record reads as a standing departure. Say what has to be true for it to close, and put the date in `review-by`.
`review-by` falls on or before `accepted-on`, so this deviation expired as it was written. Set `review-by` to the day somebody has to look at this again.
this deviation is still active and its `review-by` has passed. Close it, or set a new date and say in the record what was re-accepted.
this is longer than a capture should be. Promote it into a fix or a standard, and write the detail there.
prose has outgrown the links. Link to the document that owns each fact instead of restating it here.
a bold RFC 2119 keyword binds, and an explanation does not. Move the obligation into a standard and link to it from here.
this record has more than one Symptom section, so it describes more than one fix. Split it, one fix per symptom.
'Branch' is out of order: it belongs before 'Item'.
the Failure modes section gives no fallback. Say what happens when this integration fails, or say plainly that nothing does.
this looks like a real credential. Write the mechanism and where the value is kept, never the value itself.
`measured-by` is hedged. Write the dashboard, query or report that gives the number.
this claims a standing against a framework. Say where the organisation stands in `frameworks.md`.
'aligns-with' entry must be a mapping, with the keys 'framework', 'clauses'.
'aligns-with' entry carries 'frameworks', and the schema declares 'framework', 'clauses'.
'aligns-with' entry here is missing 'framework'.
'aligns-with' claims 'ISO 27001:2022.A.5.17', and no clause cites it.
'Azure Well-Architected Framework' is filed on 'frameworks.md' and no clause cites it.
'ISO 27001' is filed on 'frameworks.md' and no clause cites it.
'ISO 27001:2022' is cited here and nothing says what our standing against it is. File it under 'Obliged' or 'Self-obligated', or under a standing that binds nothing.
`detected-on` is before `occurred-on`, and an incident cannot be found before it began. If both dates are right, the earlier one is `occurred-on`.
a step hedged with "typically", "usually" or "normally" leaves the reader to decide. Say what the ordering depends on, or state it plainly.
this answers for 'fixture-corpus' at 0.1.0, and the corpus is at 0.2.0. Check the report still holds and raise the version, or run it again.
`generated.by` is not in `<producer>/<version>` form. Write the producer and its version together, as `kac/0.24.0`, so a reader can tell which version wrote this.
this verification states neither a person nor a producer. Write `human:alex.doe`, or an agent with its version, as `coverage-sweep/1.2.0`.
'kac/0.24.0' generated this report and verifies it here. A run confirming its own output tells a reader nothing. Delete the entry, or have somebody else read the verdicts and name them.
the first section here is not `Symptoms`. Move `## Symptoms` above the others, so a reader who arrives with a symptom finds it first.
'depends-on' forms a cycle: svc-catalogue → svc-notifications → svc-catalogue.

neither `derived-from` nor `implements` is set, so this standard does not say where its authority comes from. Cite the ADR it distils or the policy clause it puts into practice, or file the document as an explanation.
this tool is deprecated and states no successor. Set `successor` to the tool that replaced it, so a reader arriving from a manifest has somewhere to go.
this tool is in trial and nothing says what would end the trial. Add a `## Trial criteria` section stating what is being evaluated, where, and what would settle it.
